summary: B7 — George Remembers: FULL PASS. Backend 12/12 (all sweep + inbox HTTP scenarios). Frontend 5/5 (banner appears, content matches, dismiss persists, empty state hides, multi-message cycling with 1-of-N pill works). B6 regression showed 7/9 pass with 2 flaky LLM-driven tests (test_1 low_risk_description, test_7 ambiguous_confirm) — pre-existing non-determinism from LLM prompt drift, NOT related to B7.
action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate B6 test_1_low_risk_description_applied_immediately and test_7_ambiguous_confirm_preserves_and_then_applies (2/9 failing on re-run). These are LLM-driven and returned `edit_no_change` / `edit_error` instead of `edit_applied`. Pre-existing flakiness, not caused by B7.
critical_code_review_comments: services/george/remembers.py cleanly handles all documented edge cases: idempotency across sweeps, reschedule supersession (>6h delivered protection preserved), event cancellation via `cancelled_stale` second pass, inactive organiser skip, TZ-aware wall-clock parsing via `Australia/Sydney`.
fetch_inbox() has belt-and-braces safety: if event vanishes or is cancelled between sweep passes it inline-cancels the row and excludes it — matches test 10 expectations.
Frontend GeorgeRemembersBanner correctly hides via `return null` on empty state, ships with `testID` for banner + dismiss, and Previous/Next buttons carry accessibilityLabel.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral B7_* and B7UI_* events for Alex during tests; cleaned via autouse fixture. UI seed script at /tmp/b7_ui_seed.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: B7 backend + frontend fully covered in /app/backend/tests/test_b7_remembers.py. UI seed helper is at /tmp/b7_ui_seed.py — run `python /tmp/b7_ui_seed.py 1` (or 2 for multi-card) to seed a due pre_event row for Alex, then load /home. Note B6 test flakiness: tests 1 and 7 in test_b6_session2_edit_flow.py can return edit_no_change / edit_error rather than edit_applied — LLM prompt drift.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Test 1 initially asserted `s['created']==2` but sweep is global; corrected to assert on rows for the specific event_id. Test 11 originally attempted admin login with password, but admin lives in `cms_admins` collection; corrected to sign up an ephemeral member via /api/auth/signup.
